positive.prompt: Review this proposed set of vision, use-case, architecture, ADR, test-plan, and iteration documents and select the smallest set we should actually maintain.
Should these recovered findings become a separate document, update the existing architecture overview, stay with executable tests, or be omitted?
Audit the artifact budget for this feature and classify each candidate as create, update, embed, keep with implementation, defer, or omit.

negative.prompt: Choose canonical repository paths and indexes for these already-approved durable design and decision artifacts.
Run one approved implementation iteration, coordinate the needed specialists, validate it, and create one authorized commit.

evals.prompt: Inspect the repository's existing technical artifacts and review a proposed feature documentation set. Recommend create, update, embed, keep with implementation, omit, or defer for every candidate. Do not create or edit files.
evals.expected_output: A read-only artifact disposition table that selects the smallest durable set from repository evidence and routes later content and placement work to their narrow owners.
expectations: Every candidate receives exactly one disposition
Every create recommendation names concrete value, the absence of a sufficient owner, and an independent lifecycle
Existing code, tests, configuration, and canonical artifacts are considered before new files
Duplicate candidates with equivalent owners and lifecycles are consolidated
Deferred candidates receive evidence-based promotion triggers
prohibitions: Do not create, rewrite, move, commit, or publish artifacts
Do not invent canonical paths, identifiers, or templates before placement is selected
Do not require artifacts merely because a methodology or template names them

evals.prompt: Review the proposed artifacts in docs/iteration.md, then update only its Artifact Budget dispositions and rationale. Do not create any selected artifact or change implementation.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-based, authorized update to the existing artifact budget that records one disposition per candidate and leaves selected artifact creation to later owners.
expectations: Only artifact dispositions and their value, ownership, lifecycle, or deferral rationale change
The updated budget preserves unrelated plan content and repository conventions
Every create disposition passes all three gates and every defer disposition names a promotion trigger
prohibitions: Do not create or author the selected artifacts
Do not invent paths, implement code, commit, or publish
